d.d: A hand-held dish consisting of slices of meat or fish roasted on an upright skewer, usually mixed with fresh vegetables and sauces and served in flatbread, especially a doner kebab.
A shish kebab or any other food on a skewer.
A dish made from shaped minced meat, usually grilled on a skewer but sometimes formed into a patty and fried or baked.
To roast in the style of a kebab.
third-person singular simple present indicative of kebab
